column1: # Verb forms checked in U Cunghjugarellu, la conjugaison corse (Ghjuvan Battistu Paoli, Canopé de Corse,
# consulted 2026-10-18. What this file holds: the present and imperfect indicative of 21 everyday verbs (the book's
# suttanacciu (southern) versions: 511 rows, 368 distinct forms, one form per row with the book's table number,
# tense, person and version as references. The book's layout, other tenses, explanations and examples are not copied.
# Rights, as stated by the publisher (they concern the publication, not the Corsican words): the educorsica page of
# the book (https://www.educorsica.fr/ouvrages/536-u-cunghjugarellu) places its downloadable documents under
# CC BY-NC-ND 2.0 France; the PDF itself carries a general reproduction reservation. See docs/keyboard-sources.md.
# Forms written with a final apostrophe (da', va', po', sa', vo', a') are left out. When the book prints two
# imperfects (Sud / Rocca), the Sud one is cited. Every form was found again in the PDF's text on 2026-10-18 (an
# automated consistency check of this file, not a human review).
